Redline round 6

Final nit pass: reviewed only the nit fixes (61068fc..1f97b62) for correctness bugs they introduced.

The round 5 fixes reword the done rule wherever a reader meets it: the README's opening line and its Known limits entry "What a clean run means", both `.claude-plugin/` descriptions, and the product mission. They also add a docs-gate standard so a later change to the done rule rewords every statement of it. The new wording matches what docs/running.md (Rounds, step 7; The handoff comment) and the workflow's handoff sections (Deferred, For the person) actually do, and both manifests change only a string value. This diff introduces no correctness bug.

No findings.
